items.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020
items.q: even the Frank Sinatra records they didn’t have the personnel on them. We know who it is, from history you know, but they’re not listed on there.

ctx.x: Yes that’s so interesting. And it used to bother me when you’d be listening to some of these records where they wouldn’t list anybody. And God darn, I want to know who that is.

Yeah, fortunately, well a lot of these things the people are documenting them now you know, even the Frank Sinatra records they didn’t have the personnel on them. We know who it is, from history you know, but they’re not listed on there. And my wife and I were watching, we watched the movie “Soul” last night, the new Pixar movie.
